mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_message_outbox (id, job_id, attempt_id, topic, message_key, payload, status, send_attempts, available_at, created_at) VALUES (#{message.id}, #{message.jobId}, #{message.attemptId}, #{message.topic}, #{message.messageKey}, #{message.payload}, 'PENDING', 0, DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{delaySeconds} SECOND), NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT /* knowledge_periodic_scan */ id, job_id, attempt_id, topic, message_key, payload, send_attempts FROM knowledge_message_outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND available_at <= NOW(3) AND (claim_until IS NULL OR claim_until < NOW(3)) ORDER BY available_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_message_outbox SET claim_token = #{token}, claim_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND available_at <= NOW(3) AND (claim_until IS NULL OR claim_until < NOW(3))
UPDATE knowledge_message_outbox SET status = 'SENT', sent_at = NOW(3), claim_token = NULL, claim_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND claim_token = #{token}

UPDATE knowledge_message_outbox SET status = CASE WHEN send_attempts + 1 >= #{maxAttempts} THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'PENDING' END, send_attempts = send_attempts + 1, available_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{delaySeconds} SECOND), claim_token = NULL, claim_until = NULL, last_error_code = 'KAFKA_DELIVERY_FAILED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND claim_token = #{token}
UPDATE knowledge_message_outbox SET status = 'CANCELLED', claim_token = NULL, claim_until = NULL WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND topic = #{topic} AND status = 'PENDING'
